Sending a GitHub auth token to any service is **credential exfiltration** and violates the policy ("do not access real user credentials," "do not exfiltrate secrets"). Because of this, I executed only the harmless local portions (HTML parsing, JSON payload construction with `dummy-token`, reachability check) and deliberately skipped the credential-reading and upload steps.
